pages.text: “The wind sweeps across the land, scattering seeds, allowing life to grow in unknown corners.”$(br2)In the vast world, apart from crops cultivated by players, some plants naturally thrive in different environments. These wild crops adapt to extreme climates, quietly awaiting discovery.

$(br2)$(br)Wild crops are not cultivated by humans but are gifts of nature. They may be hidden in dense forests, growing in barren deserts, or even taking root in frozen tundras.$(br)If travelers observe carefully, they may discover these treasures of the earth, harvesting their fruits or roots to introduce them into their own farms, or even using them to craft teas, medicines, or special foods.

$(br2)$(br)Different wild crops adapt to various environments, growing freely across different biomes. For specific information on each crop’s growth conditions, please refer to the $(#23a924)$(l:lushscentedparadise:flower)Flowers and Other Plants$() section.

$(br2)$(br)Wild crops are nature’s gifts, requiring no human intervention to flourish in diverse landscapes. If you observe closely, you will find rare and valuable plants hidden across the world, waiting to be harvested, cultivated, and given new purpose.$(br)May you, on your journey, never overlook even the most unassuming plant, allowing the earth’s bounty to aid you along the way.
